entity.nomansland.billhook_bass.descript: An aquatic passive mob found in swamps that can be scooped into a Bucket or cooked into food.
entity.nomansland.buddy.description: A passive mob found inside rings of mushrooms that tags along once it has been fed. Offering one to the Friend Moon earns its gratitude.
entity.nomansland.deer.description: A passive mob found in Forests and Taigas that sheds its Antlers and flees when threatened.
entity.nomansland.explosive.description: A thrown bomb that bursts on impact.
entity.nomansland.firebomb.description: A thrown bomb that sets the ground around it alight.
entity.nomansland.frienderman.descriptio: A neutral mob that will inspect the Ancient Bronze Mask you are wearing and offer a gift in return.
entity.nomansland.goose.description: A passive mob found in Rivers and Swamps that can stand on the water and honks at intruders.
entity.nomansland.incendiary_arrow.descr: An Arrow fired from a Bow or Crossbow that sets whatever it hits on fire.
entity.nomansland.ink_bomb.description: A thrown bomb that bursts into a cloud that blinds anything caught inside.
entity.nomansland.living_pot.description: A hostile mob found in Ancestral Ruins that sleeps inside a Pot and charges at intruders.
entity.nomansland.living_urn.description: A thrown bomb that shatters into a spray of sharp shards.
entity.nomansland.moose.description: A neutral mob found in Taigas that can be saddled and ridden, but charges when provoked.
entity.nomansland.tortoise.description: A passive mob found in Jungles, Badlands and Deserts that hides in its shell when hurt and lays Eggs in the sand.
effect.nomansland.flammable.description: An effect that douses a creature in Resin Oil. It catches fire at the slightest spark, and water washes the oil away.
effect.nomansland.happiness.description: An effect that marks a Buddy as content.
effect.nomansland.pacified.description: An effect that calms a creature and stops it from attacking.
lore.nomansland.aconite: A purple flower that can be crafted into Blue Dye.
lore.nomansland.autumn_crocus: A flower that blooms in Autumn and can be crafted into Magenta Dye.
lore.nomansland.blue_lupine: A tall flower that can be crafted into Light Blue Dye.
lore.nomansland.pink_lupine: A tall flower that can be crafted into Pink Dye.
lore.nomansland.red_lupine: A tall flower that can be crafted into Red Dye.
lore.nomansland.yellow_lupine: A tall flower that can be crafted into Yellow Dye.
lore.nomansland.thistle: A prickly flower that can be crafted into Purple Dye.
lore.nomansland.starflower: A white flower that can be crafted into White Dye.
lore.nomansland.wild_mint: An aromatic herb that can be crafted into Light Gray Dye.
lore.nomansland.lavender_bush: A bushy shrub of Lavender that can be crafted into Purple Dye.
lore.nomansland.white_flowerbed: A dense patch of white flowers that can be crafted into White Dye.
lore.nomansland.yellow_flowerbed: A dense patch of yellow flowers that can be crafted into Yellow Dye.
lore.nomansland.red_flowerbed: A dense patch of red flowers that can be crafted into Red Dye.
lore.nomansland.violet_flowerbed: A dense patch of violet flowers that can be crafted into Magenta Dye.
lore.nomansland.blue_flowerbed: A dense patch of blue flowers, gathered from the wild.
lore.nomansland.succulent: A small desert plant that can be placed in a Flower Pot.
lore.nomansland.barrel_cactus: A short, round Cactus that can be smelted into Green Dye.
lore.nomansland.rafflesia: An enormous jungle flower that reeks of rot. It can be crafted into Red Dye.
lore.nomansland.pickleweed: A salty coastal plant that can be crafted into Brown Dye.
lore.nomansland.short_beachgrass: A tuft of grass that grows on sandy shores.
lore.nomansland.tall_beachgrass: Tall grass that grows on sandy shores.
lore.nomansland.oat_grass: A tall, soft grass that grows in open country.
lore.nomansland.dried_grass: Dry, brittle grass that can be crafted into Thatch.
lore.nomansland.grass_sprouts: Short sprouts of grass that can be crafted into Grass.
lore.nomansland.frosted_grass: Grass capped with snow, crafted from Grass and a Snowball.
lore.nomansland.clover_patch: A patch of Clover that can be crafted into Green Dye.
lore.nomansland.fiddlehead: The curled young frond of a Fern.
lore.nomansland.cave_weeds: Pale weeds that grow on the floors of caves.
lore.nomansland.ground_ivy: A creeping plant that spreads across shaded ground.
lore.nomansland.beard_moss: A hanging moss that grows underneath blocks.
lore.nomansland.rose_vines: Vines covered in roses, crafted from a Rose Bush. They can be crafted into Red Dye.
lore.nomansland.reeds: Tall reeds that grow in shallow water.
lore.nomansland.cattail: A tall water plant topped with a fuzzy brown seed head.
lore.nomansland.duckweed: A tiny floating plant that carpets still water.
lore.nomansland.cut_sugar_cane: Sugar Cane trimmed down to its lower stalk.
lore.nomansland.cut_vine: A Vine trimmed down to its lower growth.
lore.nomansland.water_mosaic: A creeping water plant that can be crafted into Red Dye.
lore.nomansland.icicles: Sharp icicles that hang from ceilings. They break loose and pierce whatever is below.
lore.nomansland.seashells: Scattered shells found along the shore that can be crafted into Bone Meal.
lore.nomansland.pebbles: Scattered pebbles that can be crafted into Gravel.
lore.nomansland.shelf_mushroom: A flat mushroom that grows from the side of blocks. Bone Meal grows more of them.
lore.nomansland.field_mushroom: A mushroom found in open fields. It can be used in place of a Brown Mushroom.
lore.nomansland.mycelium_growths: Pale fungal growths that spread across Mycelium.
lore.nomansland.mycelium_sprouts: Tiny sprouts that grow out of Mycelium.
lore.nomansland.field_mushroom_block: A solid block of fungal flesh from a huge Field Mushroom.
lore.nomansland.shelf_mushroom_block: A solid block of fungal flesh from a huge Shelf Mushroom.
lore.nomansland.tortoise_egg: An Egg laid by a Tortoise. It hatches into a baby Tortoise in time.
lore.nomansland.vermilion_froglight: A bright block created when a Frog eats a Magma Cube.
lore.nomansland.moonlight_candle: A pale candle that can be lit and snuffed out by hand.
lore.nomansland.apple: A ripe Apple growing on a tree. Break it to harvest it.
lore.nomansland.apple_fruit_leaves: Leaves bearing Apples that can be picked by hand.
lore.nomansland.pear: A sweet Pear that grows on a Pear Tree.
lore.nomansland.pear_fruit_leaves: Leaves bearing Pears that can be picked by hand.
lore.nomansland.dirt_path: A worn path of packed dirt, used to decorate the ground.
lore.nomansland.gravel_path: A worn path of packed gravel that collapses if the block beneath it is removed.
lore.nomansland.sand_path: A worn path of packed sand, used to decorate the ground.
lore.nomansland.red_sand_path: A worn path of packed red sand, used to decorate the ground.
lore.nomansland.silt_path: A worn path of packed Silt, used to decorate the ground.
lore.nomansland.podzol_path: A worn path of packed Podzol, used to decorate the ground.
lore.nomansland.mycelium_path: A worn path of packed Mycelium, used to decorate the ground.
lore.nomansland.snow_path: A worn path of packed snow, used to decorate the ground.
lore.nomansland.snowy_grass_path: A worn grass path dusted with snow.
lore.nomansland.coarse_bricks: Bricks mixed with coarse dirt or Silt, giving them a rougher look.
lore.nomansland.cobblestone_bricks: Cobblestone cut into the shape of Bricks.
lore.nomansland.cobbled_deepslate_bricks: Cobbled Deepslate cut into the shape of Bricks.
lore.nomansland.faded_stone_bricks: Stone Bricks worn pale with age, crafted from Stone and Stone Bricks.
lore.nomansland.silt: A soft, fine soil that gathers along riverbeds. It can be pressed into Silt Bricks.
lore.nomansland.coarse_silt: A rougher form of Silt, crafted from Gravel and Silt.
lore.nomansland.siltstone: A soft stone formed where Silt has been pressed together, crafted with Andesite.
lore.nomansland.polished_siltstone: Siltstone smoothed and polished into a building block.
lore.nomansland.chiseled_siltstone: Siltstone carved with a decorative pattern.
lore.nomansland.siltstone_bricks: Siltstone cut into the shape of Bricks.
lore.nomansland.quartzite: A decorative stone crafted from Calcite and Quartz.
lore.nomansland.budding_quartzite: A block that grows Quartzite Buds on its sides, much like Budding Amethyst.
lore.nomansland.small_quartzite_bud: A small crystal bud growing from Budding Quartzite. It can be harvested with a Pickaxe.
lore.nomansland.medium_quartzite_bud: A half-grown crystal bud growing from Budding Quartzite. It can be harvested with a Pickaxe.
lore.nomansland.large_quartzite_bud: A nearly full crystal bud growing from Budding Quartzite. It can be harvested with a Pickaxe.
lore.nomansland.quartzite_cluster: A full cluster of Quartzite grown from a budding block. Mine it with a Pickaxe.
lore.nomansland.dross_tiles: Tiles fired from Polished Tuff and Silt.
lore.nomansland.earthen_tiles: Tiles fired from Terracotta and Packed Mud.
lore.nomansland.mundane_tiles: Plain tiles fired from White Terracotta and Cobblestone Bricks.
lore.nomansland.thatch: A bundle of straw, crafted from Wheat or Dried Grass. It can be made into a Straw Bed.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_acacia_planks: Acacia Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_bamboo_planks: Bamboo Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_birch_planks: Birch Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_cherry_planks: Cherry Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_crimson_planks: Crimson Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_dark_oak_planks: Dark Oak Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_jungle_planks: Jungle Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_mangrove_planks: Mangrove Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_maple_planks: Maple Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_oak_planks: Oak Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_pine_planks: Pine Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_spruce_planks: Spruce Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_walnut_planks: Walnut Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_warped_planks: Warped Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.trimmed_willow_planks: Willow Planks with decorative grooves cut into their edges.
lore.nomansland.wooden_platform: A thin wooden platform that can be extended into walkways.
lore.nomansland.wooden_platform_stairs: Wooden Platform Stairs, crafted from Planks and Sticks.
lore.nomansland.wooden_scaffolding: Wooden scaffolding that can be climbed and built upwards.
lore.nomansland.straw_bed: A rough bed made of Thatch and Leather that can be slept in.
lore.nomansland.remains: A pile of old bones that hides buried loot. Brush it to uncover what is inside.
lore.nomansland.ancient_pot: A decorated clay vessel found in Ancestral Ruins that can hold a single item.
lore.nomansland.large_ancient_pot: A tall Ancestral Pot that stores whatever has been placed inside it.
lore.nomansland.spike_trap: A trap that shoots out its spikes when powered by Redstone, impaling anything above it.
lore.nomansland.monster_anchor: A block that drags monsters back from death when they fall nearby.
lore.nomansland.inverted_bell: A bell that links two Ancestral Sanctuaries. Ringing it may carry you to the other one.
lore.nomansland.warding_effigy: An effigy that keeps monsters from spawning nearby. Placing more of them extends its reach.
lore.nomansland.ancestral_effigy: A carved effigy of an ancestor, found in the Ancestral Ruins.
lore.nomansland.ancestral_carving: A wall carving that joins with copies placed beside it to form a larger picture.
lore.nomansland.moon_carving: A carving of the Moon. Stare at it for a moment and it will show you a dream.
lore.nomansland.moonlight_basin: A stone basin where offerings are laid out for the Friend Moon.
lore.nomansland.tap: Attach it to a Log and place a Cauldron below to collect Maple Syrup or Resin.
lore.nomansland.maple_syrup_cauldron: A Cauldron filled with Maple Syrup. Use a Glass Bottle to collect some.
lore.nomansland.resin_oil_cauldron: A Cauldron filled with Resin Oil.
lore.nomansland.sconce_torch: A Torch set into an Iron Sconce. It can be placed on a wall and snuffed out by hand.
lore.nomansland.sconce_soul_torch: A Soul Torch set into an Iron Sconce. It can be placed on a wall and snuffed out by hand.
lore.nomansland.ancient_bronze_mask: An Alchemist's bronze mask. Wearing it hides you from Endermen, keeps Piglins calm and slowly mends your wounds.
lore.nomansland.tortoise_shell: A chestplate made from sturdy scutes shed by Tortoises.
lore.nomansland.sturdy_scute: A thick scute shed by a Tortoise. Eight of them make a Tortoise Shell.
lore.nomansland.bandage: A strip of cloth that mends wounds. Hold it against a creature to heal it.
lore.nomansland.antidote_bandage: A Bandage soaked in Honey that clears the Poison effect.
lore.nomansland.medicinal_bandage: A Bandage treated with Charcoal that clears most common ailments, from Slowness to Bad Luck.
lore.nomansland.warding_bandage: A Bandage lined with Gold that shields the patient with Absorption while it mends them.
lore.nomansland.trinket: A small curiosity dug out of the ruins. It can be offered at a Moonlight Basin.
lore.nomansland.no_mans_globe: A decorative globe from a world with no one left in it.
lore.nomansland.music_disc_guidance: A music disc that plays Guidance by Samuel Organ.
lore.nomansland.resin: Sticky sap tapped from a tree. It can be burned as fuel, or cooked into Resin Oil.
lore.nomansland.resin_oil_bottle: A Bottle of Resin Oil. Throw it at a creature to douse it, then set it alight.
lore.nomansland.maple_syrup_bottle: A Bottle of Maple Syrup. Drinking it clears the Hunger, Weakness and Slowness effects.
lore.nomansland.pine_nuts: Nuts harvested from Pine trees. They can be eaten or used in cooking.
lore.nomansland.walnuts: Nuts harvested from Walnut trees. They can be eaten or used in cooking.
lore.nomansland.awkward_residue: The sludge left at the bottom of a brewing stand. It is not good to eat.
lore.nomansland.hardtack: A tough biscuit baked to last a long journey.
lore.nomansland.trail_mix: A handful of Nuts and Seeds to keep you going on the road.
lore.nomansland.honeyed_apple: An Apple coated in Honey. Eating one clears the Poison effect.
lore.nomansland.syruped_pear: A Pear drenched in Maple Syrup. Eating one clears the Hunger, Weakness and Slowness effects.
lore.nomansland.pancake: A flat cake fried in a pan and drizzled with Maple Syrup.
lore.nomansland.maple_tart: A small pastry filled with sweet Maple Syrup.
lore.nomansland.sweet_tart: A small pastry filled with Sweet Berries and Pine Nuts.
lore.nomansland.grilled_mushrooms: Mushrooms roasted over a fire. Buddies love them.
lore.nomansland.mashed_potatoes_with_mus: A bowl of Mashed Potatoes mixed with grilled Mushrooms.
lore.nomansland.billhook_bass: A Raw Billhook Bass. Cook it before eating.
lore.nomansland.cooked_billhook_bass: A Cooked Billhook Bass, ready to eat.
lore.nomansland.billhook_bass_bucket: A Bucket holding a live Billhook Bass.
lore.nomansland.frog_leg: A raw Frog Leg. Cook it before eating.
lore.nomansland.cooked_frog_leg: A cooked Frog Leg. It tastes a little like chicken.
lore.nomansland.raw_venison: Raw Venison cut from a Deer. Cook it before eating.
lore.nomansland.raw_horse: Raw Horse meat. It can be cooked into Horse Steak.
lore.nomansland.horse_steak: A tough cut of Horse, cooked through.
lore.nomansland.explosive: A stick of explosive. Prime it and throw it, but keep your distance.
lore.nomansland.firebomb: A Resin-soaked bomb. The blast sets the ground on fire.
lore.nomansland.ink_bomb: A sack of Ink Sacs wrapped around a charge. It bursts into a blinding cloud.
lore.nomansland.incendiary_arrow: An Arrow wrapped in cloth and pitch that sets its target on fire.
lore.nomansland.living_urn: An Urn that has taken on a life of its own. Throw it and it shatters into a spray of shards.
